name: Zul'Gurub: Jin'do the Hexxer resets after a wipe and takes his Shades with him (#5800)
contract: An evading boss walks home, leaves evade and can be pulled again, and the adds of the failed attempt leave with
it (#5800). Jin'do (11380) dances for 4 s after the raid wipes, then returns to his home position out of combat.
The Shade of Jin'do (14986) that Delusions of Jin'do makes the cursed player summon despawns with that reset
instead of staying invisible and hostile. The runner holds every step while a fixture evades, so a Jin'do that
never leaves evade times the case out. Delusions moves the cursed player to phase 3, which in the world still
shares phase 1 with Jin'do; the fixture lives in the lane's own phase, so here Jin'do already loses the hero
and resets when the Shade appears, through the same evade as after a wipe.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: no Shade of Jin'do exists before the pull
CONTROL: Delusions of Jin'do curses the hero, who summons a Shade of Jin'do with it
Let Jin'do dance, walk home and leave evade
Jin'do left evade and is out of combat
Jin'do walked back to his home position
The Shade of Jin'do despawned with the reset
